stages.label: Approved by council (zoning or subdivision)
stages.source: No region-wide list: only Kitchener publishes zoning and subdivision applications, without unit counts. See the Kitchener lens.

stages.label: Site plan approved
stages.source: No region-wide list: Kitchener and Cambridge publish site plan statuses without unit counts; Waterloo publishes none. See the city lenses.

stages.label: Building permit issued
stages.source: Sum of the three cities' building permit data (Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge; not the townships), new units on residential permits issued 2022-01-01 to each city's latest date: Kitchener 14,312, Waterloo 4,986, Cambridge 3,188. See each city lens for its dataset and licence.

stages.label: Under construction
stages.source: Table 34-10-0154-01: CMHC housing starts, under construction and completions in selected census metropolitan areas, monthly, Statistics Canada (data from Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation), https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3410015401, retrieved 2026-11-14, Statistics Canada Open Licence: housing units under construction (all types) in the Kitchener-Cambridge-Waterloo census metropolitan area at the end of 2026-09. CMHC housing starts over 2022-01 to 2026-09: 20,210 units.

stages.label: Completed
stages.source: Table 34-10-0154-01: CMHC housing starts, under construction and completions in selected census metropolitan areas, monthly, Statistics Canada (data from Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation), https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=3410015401, retrieved 2026-11-14, Statistics Canada Open Licence: housing completions (all types) in the Kitchener-Cambridge-Waterloo census metropolitan area, 2022-01 to 2026-09, summed by month.

timeBetween.note: Not measurable from public data: planning approvals and building permits are published in separate lists with no shared file number, so the same project can't be followed from approval to permit.
Not computed for the region: CMHC counts starts and completions in aggregate and doesn't follow individual projects. See the Kitchener and Cambridge lenses for permit-level medians.

target.label: Sum of Ontario's housing targets for Kitchener (35,000), Waterloo (16,000) and Cambridge (19,000): 70,000 new homes from 2022 to 2031. The province counts 15,902 homes toward them from 2022 through 2024. The townships have no provincial target. Source: https://data.ontario.ca/dataset/ontario-s-housing-supply-progress (Open Government Licence – Ontario).

hardToTrack: Approved but no building permit yet: no city publishes a list that links a council approval (zoning, subdivision or site plan) to the building permits that follow, so nobody outside city hall can count the homes waiting between approval and permit.

Construction start: permits show the day a permit was issued, not the day work began. Here 'under construction' means a permit issued since 2022 with no final inspection or occupancy yet; some of those may not have started, and some may have lapsed.

Units in permits vs units built: a permit's unit count is what was proposed. The cities don't publish how many units were finally built, so completed units here are the permit's units on permits marked finished.
One building, several permits: big projects can be split into phases or permits (and townhouse blocks into one permit per unit), so 'projects' counts permits, not buildings.
Who the homes are for: permits don't say whether units are rentals, condos or affordable homes.
Finish dates: a permit's final inspection or closing date can come months or years after people moved in, so permits 'completed' in a period are not the same as CMHC's completions for that period.

Mixed geographies: permits here cover the three cities only, while CMHC's under-construction and completion counts cover the Kitchener-Cambridge-Waterloo census metropolitan area, which also includes Woolwich and North Dumfries. The two can't be subtracted from each other.
Approval and site plan stages: only Kitchener (zoning, subdivision, site plans) and Cambridge (site plans) publish application data, and neither gives unit counts.
